Given the curve r(t)=8cos⁡ti+8sin⁡tj+6tk, t≥0, for which the arc length s from r(0) to r(t) is given by s=10t, find the corresponding unit tangent T(s), parametrized by s.

a
T(s)=−45sin⁡(s10)i+45cos⁡(s10)j+35k
b
T(s)=45sin⁡(s10)i−45cos⁡(s10)j+35k
c
T(s)=−80sin⁡(s10)i+80cos⁡(s10)j+35k
d
T(s)=−45sin⁡(10s)i+45cos⁡(10s)j+35k
e
T(s)=80sin⁡(s10)i−80cos⁡(s10)j+35k
